Ledger lookup returned a complete record set with no hits. Invoice IV-00031 (number INV-00627) from seller SL-0070 to debtor DB-0058 appears in the debtor's ledger as entry DL-00036 with matching invoice number, amount (2,639,831 EUR cents), seller and currency, status open — a single, non-duplicated open receivable consistent with the submitted advance of 2,111,864.
